ownerDecision: Mature pretrained specialist components and reliable product integration are the mainline. Training remains conditional gap-filling after the bottleneck is demonstrated, not an automatic overnight activity.
scopeOrder: A:multiple speakers taking turns without overlap, separately Chinese and English
B:overlap and speaker-conditioned recognition/separation only after A is acceptable
C:noise/far-field robustness by recording condition, followed by product recovery and deployment

existingEvidence.implication: A separator or diarizer alone cannot repair plain words already absent from raw ASR.
Even this easier whole-meeting condition misses the5% floor, with two individual speakers worse. It does not establish universal Chinese performance.

existingEvidence.case: Same exposed English words, unchanged PCM energy association
existingEvidence.implication: Deletion frequency is about twice as high in the lowest energy quartile, but43/72 deletions remain elsewhere. Energy is not target-speaker SNR; do not infer causality or apply blind gain/denoise.
Speaker activity recall and continuous identity remain a separate important failure mode; do not count an exclusive-view metric as the original multi-voice DER.

avoidRepeating: Tiny language/acoustic adapters already failed to deliver cross-source improvements; changing rank or another threshold is not evidence of a better direction.
Fixed30second MOSS improved one English source but regressed Chinese; it is not adopted as a universal replacement.
Whisper large-v3-turboQ8 on the same English set scored195/709 versus nativeQwen141/709; no broad expansion of that rejected candidate.
A third-partyQ8 CPU port was not equivalent to the native model and did not pass quality gates. No new quantization/model grid.
The existing317M-parameter acoustic-training preparation has no verified real-GPU fit, throughput or quality gain. Code readiness is not a justification to train.

specialistResponsibilities.job: Preserve waveform timing, channel/codec integrity, quiet short turns, incremental/offline continuity.
Produce faithful raw words; measure ChineseCER and EnglishWER separately before assigning speakers.
Recall all speech and keep speaker identity continuous across the full meeting; evaluate original zero-collar protocol.
Attach words to real audio times; do not use forced alignment to invent missing words.
Use diarization-conditioned target-speaker recognition or carefully admitted separation only for proved overlap needs.
Provisional incremental results and revisable offline final results; preserve raw transcript, uncertainty, recoverability and evidence links.

interpretationBranches: Both sources materially better in headset mix: investigate acoustic recording condition, actual card input and far-field robustness first; do not infer defective hardware.
Headset mix also poor: prioritize faithful recognizer/task/inference conditions and one justified mature component contrast before deciding on acoustic adaptation.
Raw words acceptable but speaker-attributed words fail: prioritize activity recall, global identity and alignment.
Effects inconsistent across sources: retain uncertainty and inspect source-specific acoustics; no universal improvement claim.

sources.supported: Recognition, word alignment and diarization are distinct components. The project also acknowledges overlap and diarization limitations.
sources.decision: Borrow tested modular responsibilities; its CUDA stack is not established as a drop-in AMD solution and its model choice is not assumed to pass our data.

sources.supported: Mono16kHz diarization, offline local usage, improved assignment/counting. Official benchmarks still show nonzero far-field meeting error.
sources.decision: An optional mature diarization comparator. Account/contact-sharing acceptance is pending; do not access credentials or bypass the gate. Not a current dependency.

sources.supported: DiCoW conditions recognition on diarization activity; SE-DiCoW uses automatic self-enrollment for overlapping regions.
sources.decision: A later evidence-backed overlap direction, not proof of Chinese gains or justification to replace current A-stage raw-word work.

sources.supported: Common word-clock acquisition synchronizes audio channels.
sources.decision: Corroborates same-meeting recorded-view timing; independent unchanged-waveform review remains attached.
